scripts.build: bun run db:generate && bun run --cwd apps/web build
scripts.typecheck: bun run db:generate && bun run --filter "*" typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --cwd apps/jobs test && bun run --cwd apps/web test
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages package.json tsconfig.base.json .prettierrc.json .github/workflows/check.yml README.md compose.yaml ARCHITECTURE.md PRODUCT.md docs/auth.md docs/deployment.md scripts/docker-smoke.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages package.json tsconfig.base.json .prettierrc.json .github/workflows/check.yml README.md compose.yaml ARCHITECTURE.md PRODUCT.md docs/auth.md docs/deployment.md scripts/docker-smoke.ts
scripts.setup: bun run db:generate && bun run db:migrate:local
